paragraphs.text: Norwood is the elven forest that covers much of the north part of Dominarian Caliman .
Norwood is famous for its featherwood trees, which were harvested by the Talas to build their ships. This mass logging led to conflicts between the Talas and the elves.
Faced with many enemies the elves had become highly militarized. The elven queen of Norwood is Arathel .
